# Cre vs GFP: pathway analysis GO gene set enrichment on the main model, its leave-one-out robustness, and over-representation analysis. ## Gene set enrichment (GO) Following the tutorial: Ensembl → Entrez with `mapIds(multiVals = "first")`, retrying unmapped genes by symbol, dropping duplicate Entrez IDs, and ranking genes by log2 fold change for `gseGO`. Two deliberate changes from the tutorial code: - the GSEA ranking uses **every tested gene** (the tutorial ranks only the significant genes, which leaves GSEA nothing to compare against), ranked by the **apeglm-shrunken** log2FC so noisy low-count genes don't dominate the extremes; - custom contigs (hAPOE, transgenes) are removed, as the tutorial removes ERCC spike-ins. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # Clear this section's previous outputs so a result that is empty this run cannot leave an # older file behind (these folders hold only files written by the pathway chunks). walk(file.path(c(CSV_DIR, FIG_DIR), "pathway"), \(d) unlink(list.files(d, full.names = TRUE))) map_entrez <- function(de) { d <- de |> dplyr::filter(!is.na(padj), str_starts(ensemblID, "ENSMUSG")) |> mutate(entrez = mapIds(org.Mm.eg.db, keys = ensemblID, column = "ENTREZID", keytype = "ENSEMBL", multiVals = "first")) miss <- is.na(d$entrez) & !is.na(d$Symbol) & d$Symbol %in% keys(org.Mm.eg.db, "SYMBOL") if (any(miss)) d$entrez[miss] <- mapIds(org.Mm.eg.db, keys = d$Symbol[miss], column = "ENTREZID", keytype = "SYMBOL", multiVals = "first") d |> dplyr::filter(!is.na(entrez)) |> dplyr::distinct(entrez, .keep_all = TRUE) } ranked_genes <- function(d) sort(set_names(d$log2FoldChange_shrunk, d$entrez), decreasing = TRUE) paths <- fits |> transmute(tissue, mapped = map(de, map_entrez), ranked = map(mapped, ranked_genes)) paths |> transmute(tissue, n_mapped = map_int(mapped, nrow)) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
````` ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # gseGO for each GO ontology (tutorial ran CC; BP and MF added) run_gsego <- function(ranked, ont) gseGO(geneList = ranked, OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db, ont = ont, keyType = "ENTREZID", minGSSize = 15, maxGSSize = 500, pvalueCutoff = PADJ_CUT, eps = 0, seed = TRUE, verbose = FALSE) |> setReadable(OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db, keyType = "ENTREZID") gsea <- expand_grid(tissue = TISSUES, ont = c("BP", "MF", "CC")) |> left_join(dplyr::select(paths, tissue, ranked), by = "tissue") |> mutate(res = map2(ranked, ont, run_gsego), n_sig = map_int(res, \(r) nrow(as.data.frame(r)))) saveRDS(dplyr::select(gsea, -ranked), file.path(OBJ_DIR, "gseGO_cre_vs_gfp.rds")) dplyr::select(gsea, tissue, ont, n_sig) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
````` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} gsea |> dplyr::filter(n_sig > 0) |> pwalk(\(tissue, ont, ranked, res, n_sig) write_tsv(as.data.frame(res), file.path(CSV_DIR, "pathway", sprintf("%s_gseGO_%s.tsv", tolower(tissue), ont)))) ``` ::: ## Leave-one-out robustness of GO terms ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # Robustness of each primary GSEA term: # - leave-one-out: GSEA rerun on the primary model refit without each 2025-10 GFP mouse # (fits$fit[[.]]$loo); must stay significant, same NES sign; # - within-run direction: GSEA on the 2025-10-only Cre vs GFP fold changes; NES must have the # same sign (direction only; that comparison has 3 GFP). # gseGO is run with every term returned (pvalueCutoff = 1) so missing terms are real misses. gsea_all <- function(lfc_tbl, ont) gseGO(geneList = ranked_genes(map_entrez(lfc_tbl)), OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db, ont = ont, keyType = "ENTREZID", minGSSize = 15, maxGSSize = 500, pvalueCutoff = 1, eps = 0, seed = TRUE, verbose = FALSE) |> as.data.frame() lfc_table <- function(res, lfc) as_tibble(as.data.frame(res), rownames = "ensemblID") |> mutate(log2FoldChange_shrunk = lfc) |> left_join(dplyr::select(id2name, ensemblID, Symbol), by = "ensemblID") fit_of <- set_names(fits$fit, fits$tissue) gsea_loo <- gsea |> dplyr::filter(n_sig > 0) |> dplyr::select(tissue, ont, res) |> mutate(loo = map2(tissue, ont, \(t, o) imap(fit_of[[t]]$loo, \(l, b) gsea_all(lfc_table(l$res, l$lfc), o) |> transmute(ID, NES_loo = NES, padj_loo = p.adjust, dropped = b)) |> bind_rows() |> (\(x) if (nrow(x)) x else tibble(ID = character(), NES_loo = double(), padj_loo = double(), dropped = character()))()), within = map2(tissue, ont, \(t, o) { w <- fit_of[[t]]$within gsea_all(lfc_table(w, w$log2FoldChange), o) |> transmute(ID, NES_within = NES) }), robust = pmap(list(res, loo, within), \(r, l, w) { n_fits <- n_distinct(l$dropped) as.data.frame(r) |> dplyr::select(ID, Description, NES, p.adjust) |> left_join(l, by = "ID") |> group_by(ID, Description, NES, p.adjust) |> summarise(n_loo = sum(!is.na(padj_loo)), loo_max_padj = suppressWarnings(max(padj_loo, na.rm = TRUE)), loo_same_sign = all(sign(NES_loo) == sign(NES[1]), na.rm = TRUE), drivers = paste(dropped[!is.na(dropped) & (is.na(padj_loo) | padj_loo >= PADJ_CUT | sign(NES_loo) != sign(NES[1]))], collapse = ";"), .groups = "drop") |> left_join(w, by = "ID") |> mutate(within_same_sign = sign(NES_within) == sign(NES), loo_ok = n_fits == 0 | (n_loo == n_fits & loo_same_sign & loo_max_padj < PADJ_CUT), robust = loo_ok & within_same_sign %in% TRUE) |> arrange(desc(robust), p.adjust) })) pwalk(dplyr::select(gsea_loo, tissue, ont, robust), \(tissue, ont, robust) write_tsv(robust, file.path(CSV_DIR, "pathway", sprintf("%s_gseGO_%s_loo_robustness.tsv", tolower(tissue), ont)))) gsea_loo |> transmute(tissue, ont, n_terms = map_int(robust, nrow), n_robust = map_int(robust, \(r) sum(r$robust))) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
````` ::: ::: ## GSEA figures ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # Tutorial plots: dotplot, ridgeplot, cnetplot, gseaplot of the top term gsea_figs <- function(tissue, ont, ranked, res, n_sig) { stem <- file.path(FIG_DIR, "pathway", sprintf("%s_gseGO_%s", tolower(tissue), ont)) ttl <- sprintf("%s · GO %s", tissue, ont) dot <- dotplot(res, showCategory = 15, split = ".sign", font.size = 6, label_format = 45) + facet_grid(~ .sign) + labs(title = ttl) + theme_bulk() + theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6)) ridge <- ridgeplot(res, showCategory = 15, label_format = 45) + labs(title = ttl, x = "Shrunken log2FC") + theme_bulk() + theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6)) cnet <- cnetplot(res, foldChange = ranked, showCategory = 5) + labs(title = ttl) + theme(text = element_text(size = 6, family = FONT), legend.text = element_text(size = 6), legend.title = element_text(size = 7), plot.title = element_text(size = 7, face = "bold")) # gseaplot2 draws tick labels at 0.8 x base_size; 8 keeps them >= 6 pt curve <- gseaplot2(res, geneSetID = 1, title = res$Description[1], base_size = 8, subplots = 1:2, rel_heights = c(1.5, 0.4)) save_plot(dot, paste0(stem, "_dotplot"), "full", 110) save_plot(ridge, paste0(stem, "_ridgeplot"), "onehalf", 110) save_plot(cnet, paste0(stem, "_cnetplot"), "full", 130) save_plot(curve, paste0(stem, "_top_term_gseaplot"), "onehalf", 80) # enrichment curves for the candidate pathways that are significant here (e.g. OXPHOS) cand_ids <- intersect(unname(CANDIDATE_TERMS), res$ID) if (length(cand_ids)) { cc <- gseaplot2(res, geneSetID = cand_ids, base_size = 8, subplots = 1:2, rel_heights = c(1.5, 0.4), title = sprintf("%s · candidate pathways", tissue)) save_plot(cc, paste0(stem, "_candidate_gseaplot"), "onehalf", 90) } list(dot = dot, ridge = ridge) } # figures show every significant term (padj < PADJ_CUT); the leave-one-out robustness of each # term is in csv/pathway/*_loo_robustness.tsv gsea_plots <- gsea |> dplyr::filter(n_sig > 0) |> dplyr::select(tissue, ont, res, n_sig) |> left_join(dplyr::select(paths, tissue, ranked), by = "tissue") |> dplyr::select(tissue, ont, ranked, res, n_sig) |> pmap(gsea_figs) walk(gsea_plots, \(x) print(x$dot)) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](05-pathways_files/figure-html/pathway-gsea-plots-1.png){width=643.2} ::: ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](05-pathways_files/figure-html/pathway-gsea-plots-2.png){width=643.2} ::: ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](05-pathways_files/figure-html/pathway-gsea-plots-3.png){width=643.2} ::: ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](05-pathways_files/figure-html/pathway-gsea-plots-4.png){width=643.2} ::: ::: ## Over-representation analysis ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # ORA of the significant genes: GO BP (enrichGO) and KEGG (enrichKEGG, as in the tutorial), # split by direction, universe = every tested gene with an Entrez ID. run_ora <- function(mapped) { sig <- dplyr::filter(mapped, padj < PADJ_CUT) sets <- split(sig$entrez, if_else(sig$log2FoldChange > 0, "Up in Cre", "Down in Cre")) if (length(sets) == 0) return(list(go = NULL, kegg = NULL)) go <- compareCluster(sets, fun = "enrichGO", OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db, keyType = "ENTREZID", ont = "BP", universe = mapped$entrez, pvalueCutoff = PADJ_CUT, qvalueCutoff = 1, # padj < PADJ_CUT is the only significance rule readable = TRUE) # KEGG is queried live from kegg.jp; skipped (NULL) if offline kegg <- tryCatch(compareCluster(sets, fun = "enrichKEGG", organism = "mmu", universe = mapped$entrez, pvalueCutoff = PADJ_CUT, qvalueCutoff = 1), error = \(e) { message("KEGG unavailable: ", conditionMessage(e)); NULL }) list(go = go, kegg = kegg) } ora <- paths |> transmute(tissue, ora = map(mapped, run_ora)) saveRDS(ora, file.path(OBJ_DIR, "ora_cre_vs_gfp.rds")) ora_out <- ora |> mutate(go = map(ora, "go"), kegg = map(ora, "kegg")) |> dplyr::select(-ora) |> pivot_longer(c(go, kegg), names_to = "db", values_to = "res") |> dplyr::filter(!map_lgl(res, \(r) is.null(r) || nrow(as.data.frame(r)) == 0)) pwalk(ora_out, \(tissue, db, res) { stem <- file.path(sprintf("%s_ORA_%s", tolower(tissue), db)) write_tsv(as.data.frame(res), file.path(CSV_DIR, "pathway", paste0(stem, ".tsv"))) p <- dotplot(res, showCategory = 10, font.size = 6, label_format = 45) + labs(title = sprintf("%s · %s", tissue, toupper(db)), x = NULL) + theme_bulk() + theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6)) save_plot(p, file.path(FIG_DIR, "pathway", paste0(stem, "_dotplot")), "onehalf", 110) print(p) }) ``` ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # Tutorial pathview diagram for the top KEGG pathway per tissue (downloads KEGG maps; writes # PNGs to the working directory, so run it from figures/pathway). library(pathview) old <- setwd(file.path(FIG_DIR, "pathway")) ora_out |> dplyr::filter(db == "kegg") |> pwalk(\(tissue, db, res) { id <- as.data.frame(res)$ID[1] pathview(gene.data = paths$ranked[[match(tissue, paths$tissue)]], pathway.id = id, species = "mmu", limit = list(gene = c(-2, 2)), low = "blue", mid = "white", high = "red", out.suffix = paste0(tolower(tissue), "_cre_vs_gfp")) }) setwd(old) ``` :::
